stem.text: A rigid rod XY has negligible mass and length $75\,\text{cm}$. The rod is suspended from a fixed point P by a string attached to end X. An object of mass $11\,\text{kg}$ is suspended by a string that is attached to the rod at a distance of $25\,\text{cm}$ from end X, as shown.

stem.alt: Horizontal rod with ends labelled X and Y, suspended from a point P by a string at end X; a length of 75 cm is marked along the rod, a distance of 25 cm is marked from X, and a box labelled 11 kg hangs from the rod.

stem.text: Which vertically upward force acting on end Y of the rod would hold the rod horizontally in equilibrium?
